integrity_notes: Arbitrary-size statements proved by induction and separator embedding; finite computations are supplementary.
Complete independent certificate at ten vertices is supplied as data and a standard-library verifier.
scientific_limitations: No exact Littlestone dimension claimed for path orders above ten.
The connected-path lower bound is proved on the subsequence with 11k-1 vertices, not asserted optimal.
Historical priority under other names may be incomplete.
title: Linear static–online shattering separation for maximal independent sets of paths
